find_evidence.name: find_evidence
find_evidence.description: Rank exact passages across opened papers (model-free).

open_paper.name: open_paper
open_paper.description: Fetch and pin one arXiv paper; returns coverage and a section outline.

get_passage.name: get_passage
get_passage.description: Return a bounded exact excerpt of an opened paper (length 1..8000).

search_papers.name: search_papers
search_papers.description: Find papers by relevance (Semantic Scholar), or by date when since/until is set.

get_citations.name: get_citations
get_citations.description: List a paper's references or the papers citing it (direction=cited_by).

get_experiment.name: get_experiment
get_experiment.description: Retrieve a brief and latest result, or select a recorded run by its ID.

save_experiment_brief.name: save_experiment_brief
save_experiment_brief.description: Save a question-only draft or revise a brief after research; references are checked.

record_experiment_result.name: record_experiment_result
record_experiment_result.description: Append supplied measurements against an exact frozen plan; runs no experiment.

freeze_experiment_plan.name: freeze_experiment_plan
freeze_experiment_plan.description: Freeze the user-agreed complete plan; does not authorize execution or spending.

list_experiments.name: list_experiments
list_experiments.description: List up to 100 recent experiment summaries with IDs and a truncation indicator.
